*Aug 19→Aug 25 vs Aug 12→Aug 18* · Revenue +21% (2,358,564 vs 1,955,228 EGP) · Spend +12% · ROAS 4.92 (+8%).
   • CPC: 2.14 → 2.44 EGP (+14%, up (drag))
   • CVR: 0.59% → 0.72% (+22%, up (good))
   • AOV: 1,644 → 1,662 EGP (+1%, ~flat)
   *Who moved it:* *CVR 58%* of the move (helped, +424,096 EGP)  ·  *CPC 38%* of the move (hurt, -58,886 EGP)  ·  *AOV 3%* of the move (helped, +25,542 EGP).
   *Read:* *CVR* rose +22%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *424,096 EGP of revenue at the same clicks*.
     That drove ROAS +8%.
     Revenue +21% because spend +12%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *farah pink*, its CVR went 0.44%→1.23% on 4,709 EGP spend (~65% of the swing).
